subject: Private deployment commercial terms & licensing — Atlas Health
messages:
From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@atlashealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing + support tiers (Atlas Health)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're evaluating Redwood for a private VPC deployment (on-prem nodes connected to our VPC) for our patient-facing inference use case. A couple of clarifying requests from procurement and engineering so we can finalize the budget:

- Can you provide a line-item commercial proposal for Private (VPC/on-prem) licensing? Specifically: platform fee, per-node or per-GPU licensing model, and any one-time onboarding or integration fees.
- What are your support tiers (SLA, response times, named contacts) and pricing for each?
- Do you offer multi-year discounts, enterprise license agreements (ELAs), or commit-based pricing for Dedicated/Private?
- Are there options to cap token costs or include quality/regression support tied to our eval suite?

We're targeting 100 inference GPUs across several clusters in year 1, with expected burst QPS in the 200–400 range. Compliance is critical (SOC2 + data residency), so please note any additional costs for KMS/HSM integration or audit support.

I've attached our procurement template for your legal/finance team. Procurement is on copy for any PO guidance. Looking for a commercial sketch by end of week if possible.

Thanks,
Michael O'Neil
Director of Platform Engineering | Atlas Health
m.oneil@atlashealth.com
Attachments: Atlas_Procurement_Template.pdf (form)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing + support tiers (Atlas Health)

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear asks and the template. High level commercial options below; I'll follow up with a short XLSX breakdown and a draft SOW.

1) Licensing models (Private/VPC/on-prem)
- Subscription (recommended for most customers): platform fee + per-GPU seat charge. Platform fee (control plane & orchestration): $75,000 / year. Per-GPU runtime license: $8,500 / GPU / month (metered monthly).
- Perpetual license: one-time license fee (list): $1,200,000 for typical footprint (up to 100 GPUs) + annual maintenance 20% of list. One-time onboarding: $45,000.

2) Support tiers
- Standard (included): 8x5 email support, 48-hour response for Sev2, product updates. No assigned TAM.
- Premium: 24x7 coverage, 4-hour response for Sev1, named Technical Account Manager (TAM), quarterly architecture reviews — 18% of annual platform fee (approx $13,500/yr).
- Enterprise: All Premium benefits + onsite onboarding days (optional), dedicated SE hours, prioritized capacity planning, and SLA credits — 30% of annual platform fee.

3) Discounts / contracting options
- 3-year commitment: eligible for 15% off platform fee or equivalent dollars off onboarding.
- Prepay year 1: additional 5% discount.
- Volume (>=100 GPUs): custom license pricing (we can look at 10%–20% off per-GPU in negotiation).

4) Compliance & integration
- SOC2: Redwood provides certificate and controls; SOC2 evidence package available under NDA.
- KMS integration (bring-your-own KMS/HSM): one-time engineering integration fee typically $12,500 (depends on vendor).

Next steps: I'll attach the pricing spreadsheet and initial SOW. If you can flag target list price you'd like us to match or an internal budget, we can propose a final commercial.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute call with Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) to walk numbers.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Tiers_v2.xlsx, SOW_Atlas_Redwood_private_v1.docx
From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@atlashealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing + support tiers (Atlas Health)

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick summary. A few clarifying points:

- Our procurement preference is subscription (OpEx) with predictable run-rate; perpetual + maintenance is a non-starter for our finite capital budget this year.
- The platform fee is the main friction for finance; can you get platform fee below $60k/year with a 3-year commitment and prepay? That would fit our internal hurdle.
- For per-GPU pricing, our finance asks if Redwood can provide an initial year discount (we'd accept a slightly higher renewal rate).
- Support: we need 24x7 coverage (Premium) and a named escalation path for HIPAA/P1. Can that be included as part of the term at a capped rate?

Also need to confirm: onboarding hours for KMS/HSM and an estimate for SOC2 evidence pull for our security audit in Q4.

Can you propose a 'starter' SOW + pricing we can circulate internally?

-Michael
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing + support tiers (Atlas Health)

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Atlas' follow-up. They want subscription + platform fee under $60k with a 3-year commit and prepay. Engineering expects ~100 GPUs in year 1. Key asks: 24x7 Premium included, KMS integration hours, and SOC2 evidence support.

Proposed internal commercial (for discussion):
- Platform fee: $75k list -> offer $60k for year 1 (20% off) if they sign a 3-year ELA and prepay year 1. Years 2/3 to revert to list plus CPI (or negotiated step).
- Per-GPU runtime license: $8,500 list -> offer $7,650/mo (10% off) for first 12 months.
- Premium support: offer as add-on at flat $13,500/yr (we can cap dollars rather than percent).
- Onboarding/KMS integration: waive $25k onboarding if they commit 3 years and prepay year 1; otherwise onboarding fee stands at $45k and KMS integration at $12.5k.

Constraints / margin: Finance prefers no more than a 15% gross discount allowance without VP approval (we need to protect margin). If we give platform fee down to $60k plus the waived onboarding, we need prepay + 3-year lock to protect customer lifetime value.

Can you confirm if legal can accept a limited price protection clause (no downward repricing for 12 months) and whether we can give a 10% below list on per-GPU for year 1 only?

Thanks — want to get this back to them today.

Laura
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing + support tiers (Atlas Health)

Laura — agree with the structure. A couple notes from finance/legal POV:
- Target: 15% off platform fee without exec sign-off. 20% would need VP approval unless they commit to prepay + 3-year ELA and an annual minimum spend.
- We should offer a one-year introductory per-GPU discount (10% off) and then move to list (or an agreed escalator) in year 2. Call that out clearly in the SOW.
- Support: we can price Premium at $13,500/yr as you suggested, but no SLA credits that materially reduce MTTD targets. Named TAM ok.
- Add clause: Redwood will provide SOC2 evidence under NDA; KMS/HSM integration fees are billable unless we agree to a funded engineering package.

I'll review the SOW language for the price-protection clause. If we want the extra 5% on platform fee (20% total) we should ask for a 12-month prepaid revenue guarantee or an equivalent termination penalty.

Rishi
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@atlashealth.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Final commercial proposal — Redwood private deployment (Atlas Health)

Michael — thanks for the patience. Based on internal alignment, here's an executable offer that should meet Atlas' procurement criteria. Attachments: updated pricing XLSX and SOW (v1).

Commercial summary (subscription path):
- Platform fee (control plane & orchestration): $60,000 for year 1 (final after 20% off list), conditional on 3-year ELA and prepayment of year 1 within 30 days of signature. Years 2–3 pricing: revert to list ($75k) with annual CPI adjustment or negotiated step as outlined in SOW.
- Per-GPU runtime license: $7,650 / GPU / month (10% off list) for the first 12 months; year 2+ at list unless otherwise negotiated.
- Premium support (24x7, named TAM, 4-hr Sev1 response): flat $13,500 / year (capped). Included in year 1 if Atlas elects to prepay the platform fee and sign the 3-year ELA; otherwise billed separately.
- Onboarding / KMS integration: We will waive a one-time onboarding fee of $25,000 if Atlas signs the 3-year ELA and prepays year 1. KMS/HSM integration hours estimated at $12,500 (billable) unless included in a funded services package.
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood will provide the SOC2 package under NDA at no charge; audit support beyond evidence delivery will be scoped separately.

Other commercial terms and caveats:
- Price protection: 12-month floor guaranteed from signature; increases thereafter subject to CPI or mutual agreement.
- Minimum revenue guarantee: to give the 20% platform discount, Redwood requests either prepay of year 1 or a 12-month non-cancellable revenue commitment.

Next steps:
1) If this looks acceptable, we'll send an ELA + SOW for legal review and a DocuSign link for signature.
2) Once signed and prepayment processed, our onboarding team will schedule kick-off and KMS integration work.

DocuSign (pricing + SOW): https://docusign.net/XYZ-123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/ATLAS-92

Looking forward to closing — happy to jump on a quick call to walk the SOW.

Best,
Laura Bennett
